messages.subject: Penrose v Caldervale - strategy after Marlowe Greaves response
messages.plaintextBody:
Team,

Marlowe Greaves' response is in (denial + £2.1m counterclaim, peak-season losses, remediation and a replacement system). The case turns on causation of the throughput shortfall. We need Counsel and an independent intralogistics expert early.

Tom - please get the papers to Harriet Stanford for an advice on merits. Elena - start scoping experts; I have Holloway Intralogistics in mind.

Sarah
